background: The Gangs of New Eden are various factions of violent and deranged outlaws that wage eternal gang wars on the streets of New Eden. These gangs are joined by mercenaries which are not bound to any particular gang, and which fight for anyone that can provide riches or a worthy cause.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Shielded
specialRules.description: Units where all models have this rule get +1 to defense rolls against hits that are not from spells.

specialRules.name: Shred
specialRules.description: On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Precision Fighter Aura
specialRules.description: This model and up to 3 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to hit rolls in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Safety Gear
specialRules.description: When units where all models have this rule are shot or charged from over 9" away, they get +1 to defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Safety Gear Boost
specialRules.description: If all models in this unit have Safety Gear, they always get +1 to defense rolls from Safety Gear (instead of only when being shot/charged from over 9" away).

specialRules.name: Rending when Shooting Aura
specialRules.description: This model and up to 3 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Rending when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Regeneration Aura
specialRules.description: This model and up to 3 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Regeneration. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Safety Gear Boost Aura
specialRules.description: This model and up to 3 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Safety Gear Boost. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Teleport Aura
specialRules.description: This model and up to 3 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Teleport. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Morale Debuff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 4 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to morale test rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Precision Frenzy
specialRules.description: Place one marker on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two markers. For each marker all models with this rule in this unit get +1 to hit rolls until the end of the game.

specialRules.name: Guarded
specialRules.description: When units where all models have this rule are shot or charged from over 9" away, they get +1 to defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: Only deploys D3 rounds afters its wave is deployed, and at the start of the round it's placed at the centre of a random table quarter.

specialRules.name: Rending
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and on unmodified results of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+4).

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Teleport
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Fearless
specialRules.description: When a unit where all models have this rule fails a morale test, roll one die. On a 4+ it counts as passed instead.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.
